brute.d: Slow and brutal. One hit drops most archers and casters.
role: Warrior
Frontline bruiser. Push forward and one-shot squishy targets.

rogue.d: One of the fastest heroes. Wins tower races.
role: Assassin
Fast flanker. Race to towers and pick off wounded units.

archer.d: Shoots at range 2-3, not point blank.
role: Ranger
Backline damage. Keep tanks in front and shoot from 2-3 hexes.
Warrior
Reliable all-rounder. Hold the center and trade evenly.

mage.d: Fireball hits the target, and its neighbors for half damage. Costs 2 mana.
role: Mage
Burst caster. Fireball clusters and save mana for it.

cleric.d: Heals an ally for 5 (1 mana), or pokes an enemy.
role: Healer
Backline healer. Stay behind allies and keep key units alive.

colossus.d: Huge and slow. Takes 1 less damage per hit.
role: Tank
Meat shield. Plant it in front and soak up damage.

blade.d: Heals 2 whenever it hits a unit.
role: Warrior
Sustain fighter. Stays alive by draining with every hit.

lancer.d: Charges in and strikes in the same turn. Its spear pierces 2 hexes in a straight line and hits both.
role: Warrior
Charging pierce striker. Rides in and spears 2 hexes in a straight line in one turn, so line enemies up.

guard.d: Takes 2 less damage. Hits stun the target for its next turn.
role: Tank
Control tank. Stun dangerous enemies and block lanes.

sapper.d: Weak in a fight, deals +6 to towers.
role: Siege
Tower buster. Sneak to a tower for big damage.

wraith.d: Moves through units and slips past blockers.
role: Assassin
Slippery diver. Ghost through the line to reach the backline.

bomber.d: Free splash: hits the target, and its neighbors for half damage.
role: Ranger
Area ranged. Punish clumped units with free splash damage.

witch.d: Free with Arcane Flow. Freezes a unit out of its next turn.
role: Mage
Controller. Freeze threats out of their next turn.

storm.d: Costs 2 mana. Huge damage from range 2-3.
role: Mage
Sniper caster. Spend 2 mana for huge damage at long range.

druid.d: Free heal of 4 on an ally, or pokes an enemy.
role: Healer
Free healer. Small repeatable heals with no mana cost.

paladin.d: Fights in melee. Heals an ally for 3 (1 mana).
role: Warrior
Frontline fighter with emergency heals for nearby allies.

warlock.d: Costs 1 mana. Hits at exactly range 2 and heals 2. Bat Form (free, before moving): fly like a Bat this turn and turn back on landing.
role: Mage
Drain caster. Chips from exactly 2 hexes and heals itself. Bat Form: flies like a Bat for one move.

assassin.d: Fragile, but one hit drops most archers, casters and scouts.
role: Assassin
Glass cannon. Delete one key target, then expect to fall.

ballista.d: Slow siege weapon. Range 3-4, +2 to towers.
role: Siege
Siege engine. Slowly shells towers from 3-4 hexes away.

footmen.d: A squad of 3 spearmen. Takes 1 less damage.
role: Shield Wall
Armored line. Walk them in front of your shooters and soak hits with 3 bodies.

bowmen.d: A squad of 3 archers. Volleys from range 2-3.
role: Volley
Back-line shooters. Three arrows per turn from range 2-3. Keep them behind a wall.
Harrier
Flying pests. Skip past blockers to chip towers and pull enemies out of position.

raiders.d: A pack of 3 fast raiders that charge in and strike in the same turn.
role: Flanker
Charging pack. Dash in and strike in the same turn to kill one lone target or hurt a tower.
Skirmisher
Evasive fliers. Reach over the front line with range 2 and finish wounded units.

dragon.d: Elite (5 slots). A flying drake whose fire breath burns the target and splashes its neighbors for half damage. Costs 2 mana.
role: Boss
Air power. Breathe fire on clusters for 2 mana.

titan.d: Elite (5 slots). A heavy, armored giant. Its earthquake slam stuns the target and cleaves the 2 hexes beside it for half damage.
role: Boss
Unstoppable wall. Crushes towers and the enemy front rank.

archmage.d: Elite (5 slots). A fragile caster. Meteor Storm costs 1 mana and blasts an area.
role: Boss
Area wipe. Save 3 mana for a devastating meteor storm.

bats.d: Three vampire bats take the field together. Fast fliers that feed with every bite.
role: Harrier
Flying bloodsuckers. Drain life from the backline and heal as they fight.

thrall.d: A chained, bloodied servant. Slow and tough, and it feeds on its victims.
role: Tank
Draining tank. Holds the front and heals by hitting.

countess.d: A noble sorceress. Crimson bolts from range 2-3 cost 1 mana and drain life.
role: Mage
Life-drain caster. Hits from range 2-3 and heals herself.

skeletons.d: A squad of 3 skeletons. Each rises once after falling.
role: Shield Wall
Re-rising squad. Each body can fall once and come back.

ghoul.d: A ravenous grave-dweller with heavy claws.
role: Warrior
Heavy bruiser that comes back after being killed.

necromancer.d: A frail summoner. Death bolts from range 2-3 cost 1 mana. Raise the Slain: enemy heroes it kills rise as Undead that fight for it for 3 turns.
role: Mage
Cheap, fragile caster. Spams death bolts from behind a wall and raises the heroes it kills as temporary Undead.

graveknight.d: An armored dead champion that refuses to stay down.
role: Tank
Undying tank. Soak a hit, rise, soak again.

hellhound.d: A blazing hound that charges in and sets targets alight in the same turn.
role: Flanker
Charging igniter. Runs in and bites in one turn, then burns the target down over time.

magmagolem.d: A walking furnace of molten rock. Slow, armored and burning.
role: Tank
Burning wall. Slow tank whose hits leave targets on fire.

wolves.d: A pack of 3 wolves. They charge in and bite in the same turn, and heal as they run.
role: Flanker
Charging pack with regrowth. Runs down wounded units and bites in the same turn.

treant.d: An ancient tree-guardian. Huge health pool that slowly regrows.
role: Tank
Regrowing wall. Huge HP that heals every turn.

gunner.d: A dwarven marksman. Powder blasts from range 2-3, with Iron Clan siegecraft against towers.
role: Ranger
Iron Clan marksman. Shoots from range 2-3 and chips towers.

sentinel.d: A rune-etched construct that guards the order's casters.
role: Tank
Arcane guardian. Armored front-liner that protects casters.

spellblade.d: A mage-warrior. Enchanted strikes are free with Arcane Flow.
role: Warrior
Mana-fuelled duelist. Hits hard, but every strike costs 1 mana.
Healer
Cheap healer. Heals for 4 for 1 mana.

outrider.d: A light horseman. Gallops in and strikes in the same turn, but cannot take a beating.
role: Cavalry
Hit and run. Gallop in and strike in one turn, then keep out of reach.

boarrider.d: A tusked war-boar and its wild rider. Charges in and gores, then slowly regrows.
role: Cavalry
Sturdy charger. Gores a target in one turn and regrows between fights.

bonerider.d: A skeleton on a skeletal steed. Rides down a target and rises once when it falls.
role: Cavalry
Reckless charger. Rides in, strikes, and rises once when it falls.

bloodhunter.d: A vampire knight on a black steed. Charges, bites and drains blood in one turn.
role: Cavalry
Draining charger. Strikes in one turn and heals from the bite.

kinglion.d: Elite (5 slots). The armored king of the realm. His great sword cleaves the target and the 2 hexes beside it.
role: Boss
Front-line king. Cleaves the enemy front rank and shrugs off hits with armor.

vlord.d: Elite (5 slots). An ancient lord on bat wings. Blood Nova cleaves the target and the 2 hexes beside it, and drains the life from his prey.
role: Boss
Flying lifestealer. Dives in, cleaves the front rank and drains his prey.

lich.d: Elite (5 slots). A crowned sorcerer of the grave. Soul Storm costs 2 mana, hits an area and stuns the target. Raise Dead: 2 mana summons a skeleton beside him.
role: Boss
Grave sorcerer. Blasts and stuns clusters, or spends 2 mana to raise skeletons beside him (green hexes).

mammoth.d: Elite (5 slots). A towering beast of the old forest. Its stampede knocks the target down and tramples the 2 hexes beside it.
role: Boss
Stampeding beast. Tramples the front rank, hurts every enemy it stops next to and knocks targets down.

trapper.d: Hides snares (1 mana, up to 3). An enemy that walks onto one stops there and cannot move on its next turn.
role: Trapper
Area denial. Lay snares on enemy paths, then poke from range 2.

wallwright.d: Builds 6 HP stone walls next to itself (2 mana, up to 3). Walls block movement and ranged shots.
role: Engineer
Builds walls that block movement and arrows. Wall off lanes and shield your towers.

hexweaver.d: Casts Silence (1 mana) on a 3-hex-wide area up to 3 away. Enemies there cannot attack or use abilities on their next turn.
role: Mage
Silencer. Shuts down a cluster of enemies for a turn.

seraph.d: Boss (5 slots). Holy Aura: At the start of your turn, allies next to her and she herself heal 1.
role: Boss
Healer boss. At the start of your turn, allies next to her and she herself heal 1.

warlord.d: Boss (5 slots). War Banner: Your other heroes within 2 hexes deal +1 damage.
role: Boss
Warrior boss. Your other heroes within 2 hexes deal +1 damage.

templar.d: Boss (5 slots). Tower Shield: Attacks from 2 or more hexes away deal half damage to him.
role: Boss
Tank boss. Attacks from 2 or more hexes away deal half damage to him.

marshal.d: Boss (5 slots). Momentum: When he defeats a unit he may act again (once per turn).
role: Boss
Cavalry boss. When he defeats a unit he may act again (once per turn).

bloodqueen.d: Boss (5 slots). Exsanguinate: Defeating a unit heals her to full.
role: Boss
Assassin boss. Defeating a unit heals her to full.

nosferatu.d: Boss (5 slots). Mist Step: Flies 4 hexes. After it attacks it turns to mist and takes 2 less damage until its next turn.
role: Boss
Assassin boss. Flies 4 hexes. After it attacks it turns to mist and takes 2 less damage until its next turn.

matriarch.d: Boss (5 slots). Blood Pact: Each hit steals 1 mana from the target's player.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Each hit steals 1 mana from the target's player.

batking.d: Boss (5 slots). Swarm Call: The first time it is hit each round a Bat appears next to it (up to 3).
role: Boss
Summoner boss. The first time it is hit each round a Bat appears next to it (up to 3).

bonecolossus.d: Boss (5 slots). Ossuary: When it falls it breaks into 3 skeletons.
role: Boss
Tank boss. When it falls it breaks into 3 skeletons.

deathknight.d: Boss (5 slots). Withering Strike: Its targets cannot be healed for 2 turns.
role: Boss
Warrior boss. Charges in, and its targets cannot be healed for 2 turns.

banshee.d: Boss (5 slots). Wail: Each attack also deals 1 damage to every other enemy next to her.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Each attack also deals 1 damage to every other enemy next to her.

plaguelord.d: Boss (5 slots). Plague Aura: Enemies that start their turn next to him take 2 damage.
role: Boss
Tank boss. Enemies that start their turn next to him take 2 damage.

pitlord.d: Boss (5 slots). Immolation: At the start of your turn enemies next to him take 2 damage and burn.
role: Boss
Tank boss. At the start of your turn enemies next to him take 2 damage and burn.

infernowitch.d: Boss (5 slots). Hellfire: Her targets burn for 2 damage a turn for 3 turns.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Her targets burn for 2 damage a turn for 3 turns.

demonprince.d: Boss (5 slots). Hellgate: At the start of your turn an Imp crawls out next to him (up to 2 at a time).
role: Boss
Summoner boss. At the start of your turn an Imp crawls out next to him (up to 2 at a time).

phoenix.d: Boss (5 slots). Rebirth: The first time it falls it rises again with half HP.
role: Boss
Undying boss. The first time it falls it rises again with half HP.

eldertreant.d: Boss (5 slots). Entangle: Its hits root the target: it cannot move on its next turn.
role: Boss
Tank boss. Its hits root the target: it cannot move on its next turn.

direwolf.d: Boss (5 slots). Pack Howl: Your other heroes within 2 hexes get +1 move.
role: Boss
Assassin boss. Charges in to strike, and your other heroes within 2 hexes get +1 move.

stormroc.d: Boss (5 slots). Gale: Its hits push the target 1 hex away. If the target cannot move it takes 1 more damage.
role: Boss
Control boss. Its hits push the target 1 hex away. If the target cannot move it takes 1 more damage.

cavebear.d: Boss (5 slots). Thick Hide: Heals 3 at the start of your turn and gets +1 armor below half HP.
role: Boss
Tank boss. Heals 3 at the start of your turn and gets +1 armor below half HP.

warengine.d: Boss (5 slots). Ballistic Arc: Its shells fly over walls and ignore line of sight, and splash every enemy next to the target for half damage.
role: Boss
Siege boss. Its shells fly over walls and ignore line of sight, and splash every enemy next to the target for half damage.

forgemaster.d: Boss (5 slots). Field Repairs: At the start of your turn he heals adjacent allies 2 and repairs your weakest tower by 1.
role: Boss
Healer boss. At the start of your turn he heals adjacent allies 2 and repairs your weakest tower by 1.

juggernaut.d: Boss (5 slots). Spiked Plating: Melee attackers take 2 damage. Immune to stun, snares and silence.
role: Boss
Tank boss. Melee attackers take 2 damage. Immune to stun, snares and silence.

thunderking.d: Boss (5 slots). Chain Lightning: Each hit arcs to up to 2 more enemies within 2 hexes of the target for 2 damage.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Each hit arcs to up to 2 more enemies within 2 hexes of the target for 2 damage.

chronomancer.d: Boss (5 slots). Time Slow: Enemies within 2 hexes of her have -1 move.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Enemies within 2 hexes of her have -1 move.

voidlord.d: Boss (5 slots). Mana Burn: Each hit burns 2 mana from the target's player and gives you 1.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Each hit burns 2 mana from the target's player and gives you 1.

mirrormage.d: Boss (5 slots). Reflection: Half the damage it takes (rounded up) is reflected back to the attacker.
role: Boss
Mage boss. Half the damage it takes (rounded up) is reflected back to the attacker.

runekeeper.d: Boss (5 slots). Rune Ward: The first hit it takes each round deals no damage.
role: Boss
Tank boss. The first hit it takes each round deals no damage.

raidboss.d: The raid boss. Huge health, cleaving blows, enrages at 2/3 HP and raises skeletons at 1/3.
role: Boss
The raid boss. Surround it, but do not bunch up.

lookout.d: Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Eyes of the crown. Spot hidden enemies and mark them for your army.

nightwatch.d: Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Silent sentry. Hunts in the dark and lights the way for the hunt.

wisp.d: Flying. Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Floating lantern of the dead. Drifts over the line to reveal what hides behind it.

fireeye.d: Flying. Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
A burning eye on wings. Sees far and scorches from range 2.

falconer.d: Sees 5 hexes. Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Her falcon sees everything. Long sight and long range, little punch.

spotter.d: Sees 5 hexes. Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Spyglass on a tripod. Sees 5 hexes and calls in the shots.

oracle.d: Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.
role: Scout
Reads the stars. Reveals and marks clusters of enemies.

sunspeaker.d: A herald of noon. Marks a hex for a delayed 5-damage Noon Verdict (3 mana).
role: Mage
Zone striker. Mark choke points, towers and stunned enemies with a delayed Noon Verdict.

aegis.d: A war chaplain. Shields an ally or tower before the blow lands (2 mana).
role: Support
Bodyguard caster. Shield the ally about to be hit, or a tower under siege.

herald.d: Sounds the rally: pulls a friendly hero to his side from 4 hexes away (2 mana).
role: Support
Rescuer and flanker. Pull a wounded ally out, or a fresh fighter into the fight.

hemomancer.d: Binds an enemy with a Crimson Tether that drains it for 3 turns (2 mana).
role: Mage
Drain caster. Tether a slow, tough target and stay within 4 hexes of it.

mesmerist.d: Charms an enemy hero into striking one of its own allies (3 mana).
role: Controller
Turncoat maker. Charm a big hitter into its own backline.

duskweaver.d: Weaves a Veil of Night that hides your units from enemy eyes and arrows (2 mana).
role: Support
Night cover. Veil your shooters or a shrine from enemy fire.

ossomancer.d: Detonates spent or summoned undead as a 4-damage burst of Bone Shrapnel (1 mana).
role: Mage
Bone bomber. Detonate risen or summoned undead next to enemy clusters.

bonewitch.d: Ossifies an enemy hero into a weak skeleton for a turn (3 mana).
role: Controller
Curse caster. Ossify the enemy carry for a turn and pile in.

gravedigger.d: Digs Open Graves you can spawn next to, and earns gold from enemy deaths nearby (2 mana).
role: Economist
Forward spawner. Dig a grave near the front and grow rich on nearby deaths.

cinderwarden.d: Raises a 3-hex Wall of Flame that burns enemies who cross it (2 mana).
role: Mage
Zone burner. Wall off lanes and towers with fire.

hellbinder.d: Hooks an enemy from 4 hexes away and drags it into your lines (2 mana).
role: Controller
Hooker. Drag a backline caster into your melee.

pactbroker.d: Trades an ally's blood for mana and gold with a Devil's Bargain (free).
role: Economist
Mana dealer. Trade spare HP for mana and gold.

beastcaller.d: Sends a Thundering Herd down a line, hitting and pushing every enemy in it (3 mana).
role: Mage
Line clearer. Stampede through squads and push them off shrines.

groveshaper.d: Sinks 7 hexes into a swamp that stops walking enemies (2 mana).
role: Controller
Terrain shaper. Bog down a lane in front of your towers.

skinchanger.d: Takes the body of any non-boss hero within 2, ally or enemy (2 mana).
role: Support
Shapeshifter. Borrow the best body on the field.

runeforger.d: Runeforges an ally's weapon: its next hit deals +3 and ignores armor (2 mana).
role: Support
Armor breaker. Runeforge a big hitter before it strikes.

cagewright.d: Drops an Iron Cage on any non-boss hero: it can neither act nor be hurt (3 mana).
role: Controller
Jailer. Cage the enemy threat, or save your own dying hero.

prospector.d: Strikes a rich vein in your mine and guards mines from enemy claims (2 mana).
role: Economist
Mine boss. Hold the mines and strike veins for extra gold.

aetherlancer.d: Pours X mana into an Overflow Lance that pierces a whole line (X mana).
role: Mage
Mana gun. Bank mana, then pour it into one big line shot.

phasewright.d: Swaps the places of any two units near her with Transposition (2 mana).
role: Controller
Swapper. Trade places to rescue allies or drop enemies into traps.

hourglass.d: Rewinds an ally to where and how it stood at the start of your last turn (2 mana).
role: Support
Time mender. Undo the damage your ally took since your last turn.

kingdom.pd: takes 1 less damage while next to another Kingdom unit.

vamp.pd: every attack drains blood, healing the attacker for 2 HP, but never more than the damage dealt.
vamp.x: Night Falls: rounds 1-3 are Day, 4-6 Night, and so on (only in matches with Vampires). At Night vampires get +1 move and +1 drain, and every other faction has -2 sight (min 1). Bat Form (Warlock): before moving he can turn into a bat for free (🦇 button or B) and fly like a Bat; he turns back when he lands.

undead.pd: the first time it would die, it rises again with 1 HP.
undead.sy: Undying returns units with 2 HP instead of 1.
undead.x: Graves: every non-summoned unit that dies leaves a Grave for 4 rounds (max 6, the oldest crumbles). Undead heroes may spawn next to a Grave within 3 hexes of an Undead unit, but not within 2 hexes of an enemy tower. A non-Undead hero that ends its turn on a Grave consecrates it. Graves have nothing to do with a Necromancer’s Raise the Slain: a raise never uses up a Grave. Vengeful Dead: a unit that has used Undying is Risen (glowing red eyes): +1 damage, but allied heals cannot heal it (shrines still do).

infernal.pd: its attacks set units ablaze: 1 damage at the start of their owner's next 2 turns. Infernal heroes never burn and take no damage from fire abilities (Wall of Flame, Rain of Fire, Fireball cards, Immolation, a dragon's fly-over); normal attacks still hurt them.
infernal.x: Scorched Earth: Infernal splash attacks (and Overheats), Infernal killing blows and Infernal deaths ignite the hex: Burning Ground for 2 rounds (max 8, oldest out first). Non-Infernal walking heroes that enter or start there take 1 damage and Burn; fliers and Infernal are immune. Burned forest becomes Ash (no cover) for the match (max 4 Ash). Fire burns away Graves. Heat: every Burn tick on an enemy gives your side +1 Heat (max 10). At 5, your next Infernal attack Overheats: +2 damage and splash, spending 5 Heat.

wilds.pd: heals 2 HP at the start of its owner's turn.
wilds.x: Hidden Paths (Rogue, Trapper, Archer, Boar Rider, Wolf Pack, Falconer, Druid): in a forest they are hidden from enemies more than 1 hex away, even inside sight, unless flared or they attacked last turn; they also ignore the swamp stop. Overgrowth (Treant, Elder Treant): one that did not move last turn turns its plain hex into forest at the start of your turn (6 grown forests per side, the oldest reverts). Pack Bond (Wolf Pack, Alpha Direwolf): +1 melee damage per other Wilds unit next to the target (max +2).

iron.sy: every Iron Clan unit deals +1 damage.

arcane.pd: attacks cost 1 less mana (1-mana attacks are free); spells and heals that cost 2+ mana cost 1 less.
arcane.sy: your side gains +2 mana at the start of every turn.

classes.Cavalry: Charge riders. They move and attack in the same turn, but are fragile and hit softly.
classes.Tank: Soaks damage and holds the line.
classes.Warrior: Frontline fighters that deal steady melee damage.
classes.Assassin: Fast, fragile units that kill one key target or race to a tower.
classes.Ranger: Attack from a distance and need protection.
classes.Mage: Mana-powered casters with strong special abilities.
classes.Healer: Keep allies alive but are weak on their own.
classes.Shield Wall: Squad of 3 bodies. Screens the backline and soaks hits for the team.
classes.Volley: Squad of 3 ranged shooters. Spreads damage across several targets from behind the line.
classes.Harrier: Squad of 3 flying pests. Ignores blockers to chip towers and distract enemies.
classes.Flanker: Fast attackers, mostly squads of 3. Sprint in to gang up on one target or a tower.
classes.Skirmisher: Squad of 3 tiny fliers. Hits from range 2 and finishes off wounded units.
classes.Boss: Elite units that take 5 slots and play attack cutscenes.
classes.Scout: See far through the fog of war and fire flares that reveal and mark enemies.
classes.Trapper: Hide snares that stop and root enemies that walk onto them.
classes.Engineer: Build walls that block movement and line of sight.
classes.Support: Spellcasters that protect, move and empower allies.
classes.Controller: Spellcasters that charm, cage, curse, pull or swap enemies.
classes.Economist: Spellcasters that turn mana, HP and mines into gold and spawn points.

farm.d: +1 gold at the start of each of your turns.

tower.d: Sees 4 hexes through the fog of war.

barracks.d: Spawn heroes next to it, just like next to a tower.

well.d: +1 mana at the start of each of your turns.

cottage.d: +2 army slots, so you can hire more.

hall.d: +5 army slots, so you can hire more.
